v.en: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.
v.zh: 我用嘴唇传扬你口中的一切典章。

v.en: “There is no peace”, says the LORD, “for the wicked.”
v.zh: 耶和华说：恶人必不得平安！

v.en: Bilhah conceived, and bore Jacob a son.
v.zh: 辟拉就怀孕，给雅各生了一个儿子。

v.en: Your silver has become dross, your wine mixed with water.
v.zh: 你的银子变为渣滓；你的酒用水搀对。

v.en: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.
v.zh: 你安置月亮为定节令；日头自知沉落。

v.en: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.
v.zh: 神在其宫中，自显为避难所。

v.en: The confused city is broken down. Every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
v.zh: 荒凉的城拆毁了；各家关门闭户，使人都不得进去。

v.en: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
v.zh: 他们行恶使君王欢喜，说谎使首领喜乐。

v.en: Thus Israel lived in the land of the Amorites.
v.zh: 这样，以色列人就住在亚摩利人之地。

v.en: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day.
v.zh: （安息日的诗歌。）

v.en: The man bowed his head, and worshiped the LORD.
v.zh: 那人就低头向耶和华下拜，

v.en: At their presence the peoples are in anguish. All faces have grown pale.
v.zh: 它们一来，众民伤恸，脸都变色。

v.en: A Psalm. A Song for the Dedication of the Temple. By David.
v.zh: （大卫在献殿的时候，作这诗歌。）

v.en: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.
v.zh: 他给他们降下冰雹为雨，在他们的地上降下火焰。

v.zh: 亚伯拉罕就在那地的人民面前下拜，

v.zh: 我要使他的左手伸到海上，右手伸到河上。

v.en: In God, I will praise his word. In the LORD, I will praise his word.
v.zh: 我倚靠神，我要赞美他的话；我倚靠耶和华，我要赞美他的话。

v.en: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.
v.zh: 沧海看见就奔逃；约旦河也倒流。

v.zh: 我们是无父的孤儿；我们的母亲好像寡妇。

v.zh: 耶和华听了我的恳求；耶和华必收纳我的祷告。

v.zh: 耶和华吩咐我说：

v.zh: 这悖逆、污秽、欺压的城有祸了！

v.zh: 并且所罗门登了国位。

v.en: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.
v.zh: 他们的眼睛因体胖而凸出；他们所得的，过于心里所想的。

v.zh: 我的仇敌转身退去的时候，他们一见你的面就跌倒灭亡。

v.en: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.
v.zh: 至于我，却要行事纯全；求你救赎我，怜恤我！

v.en: one male goat for a sin offering;
v.zh: 一只公山羊作赎罪祭；

v.zh: 法老就预备他的车辆，带领军兵同去，

v.zh: 你安置月亮为定节令；日头自知沉落。

v.zh: 以眼传神的，使人忧患；口里愚妄的，必致倾倒。

v.zh: 神上升，有喊声相送；耶和华上升，有角声相送。

v.zh: 我追想古时之日，上古之年。

v.zh: 他背了约，伸手攻击与他和好的人。

v.zh: 大卫的死期临近了，就嘱咐他儿子所罗门说：

v.en: for they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.
v.zh: 因为他们吞了雅各，把他的住处变为荒场。

v.en: For the Chief Musician. By David, the servant of the LORD.
v.zh: （耶和华的仆人大卫的诗，交与伶长。）

v.en: “‘He shall take a wife in her virginity.
v.zh: 他要娶处女为妻。

v.en: seventy-two thousand head of cattle,
v.zh: 牛七万二千只；

v.en: The LORD is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.
v.zh: 凡等候耶和华，心里寻求他的，耶和华必施恩给他。

v.en: The priest shall burn it on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire to the LORD.
v.zh: 祭司要在坛上焚烧，是献给耶和华为食物的火祭。

v.en: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
v.zh: 我这困苦人呼求，耶和华便垂听，救我脱离一切患难。

v.en: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.
v.zh: 他使我的力量中道衰弱，使我的年日短少。

v.en: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.
v.zh: 他要报应我仇敌所行的恶；求你凭你的诚实灭绝他们。

v.en: But if he doesn’t wash them, or bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.’”
v.zh: 但他若不洗衣服，也不洗身，就必担当他的罪孽。」

v.en: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.
v.zh: 我与野狗为弟兄，与鸵鸟为同伴。

v.en: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.
v.zh: 我要打伤他们，使他们不能起来；他们必倒在我的脚下。

v.en: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.
v.zh: 革舜的长子是细布业；

v.en: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
v.zh: 他医好伤心的人，裹好他们的伤处。

v.en: The name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.
v.zh: 亚设的女儿名叫西拉。

v.en: so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety.
v.zh: 将卑微的安置在高处，将哀痛的举到稳妥之地；

v.en: The children of Jorah, one hundred twelve.
v.zh: 约拉的子孙一百一十二名；

v.en: Therefore with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation.
v.zh: 所以，你们必从救恩的泉源欢然取水。

v.en: Gather yourselves together, yes, gather together, you nation that has no shame,
v.zh: 不知羞耻的国民哪，你们应当聚集！趁命令没有发出，日子过去如风前的糠，耶和华的烈怒未临到你们，他发怒的日子未到以先，你们应当聚集前来。

v.en: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in man.
v.zh: 投靠耶和华，强似倚赖人；

v.en: Then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.
v.zh: 狂傲的水必淹没我们。

v.en: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in man.
v.zh: 投靠耶和华，强似倚赖人；

v.en: They traveled from Kehelathah, and encamped in Mount Shepher.
v.zh: 从基希拉他起行，安营在沙斐山。

v.en: A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.
v.zh: 境内有打仗和大毁灭的响声。

v.en: A mighty king will stand up, who will rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.
v.zh: 必有一个勇敢的王兴起，执掌大权，随意而行。

v.en: Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
v.zh: 雅各仍旧行路，神的使者遇见他。

v.en: The children of Immer, one thousand fifty-two.
v.zh: 音麦的子孙一千零五十二名；

v.en: The LORD’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.
v.zh: 耶和华的声音使火焰分岔。

v.en: But whenever raw flesh appears in him, he shall be unclean.
v.zh: 但红肉几时显在他的身上就几时不洁净。

v.en: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him. Let him be filled full of reproach.
v.zh: 他当由人打他的腮颊，要满受凌辱。

v.en: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.
v.zh: 试看恶人因奸恶而劬劳，所怀的是毒害，所生的是虚假。

v.en: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,
v.zh: 无赖的恶徒，行动就用乖僻的口，

v.en: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.
v.zh: 耶和华啊，你曾将你的训词吩咐我们，为要我们殷勤遵守。

v.en: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.
v.zh: 主发命令，传好信息的妇女成了大群。

v.en: His brothers envied him, but his father kept this saying in mind.
v.zh: 他哥哥们都嫉妒他，他父亲却把这话存在心里。

v.en: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise the LORD!
v.zh: 你们当向圣所举手，称颂耶和华！

v.en: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.
v.zh: 他们记念你的大恩就要传出来，并要歌唱你的公义。

v.en: But Noah found favor in the LORD’s eyes.
v.zh: 惟有挪亚在耶和华眼前蒙恩。

v.en: Ephraim has bitterly provoked anger. Therefore his blood will be left on him, and his Lord will repay his contempt.
v.zh: 以法莲大大惹动主怒，所以他流血的罪必归在他身上。主必将那因以法莲所受的羞辱归还他。

v.en: He has made me dwell in dark places, as those who have been long dead.
v.zh: 他使我住在幽暗之处，像死了许久的人一样。

v.en: The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.
v.zh: 他屈身蹲伏，无倚无靠的人就倒在他爪牙（爪牙：或译强暴人）之下。

v.en: There were born to him seven sons and three daughters.
v.zh: 他生了七个儿子，三个女儿。

v.en: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.
v.zh: 他要按公义审判你的民，按公平审判你的困苦人。

v.en: Yet the chief cup bearer didn’t remember Joseph, but forgot him.
v.zh: 酒政却不记念约瑟，竟忘了他。

v.en: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.
v.zh: 天的柱子因他的斥责震动惊奇。

v.en: On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps.
v.zh: 我们把琴挂在那里的柳树上；

v.en: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.
v.zh: 并将他的百姓交与刀剑，向他的产业发怒。

v.en: Moses built an altar, and called its name “The LORD our Banner”.
v.zh: 摩西筑了一座坛，起名叫「耶和华尼西」（就是耶和华是我旌旗的意思），

v.en: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
v.zh: 他们的偶像是金的，银的，是人手所造的，

v.en: until I find out a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”
v.zh: 直等我为耶和华寻得所在，为雅各的大能者寻得居所。

v.en: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,
v.zh: 我若展开清晨的翅膀，飞到海极居住，

v.en: Jehoash was seven years old when he began to reign.
v.zh: 约阿施登基的时候年方七岁。

v.en: You shall make settings of gold,
v.zh: 要用金子做二槽，

v.en: It went down from Janoah to Ataroth, to Naarah, reached to Jericho, and went out at the Jordan.
v.zh: 从雅挪哈下到亚他绿，又到拿拉，达到耶利哥，通到约旦河为止；

v.en: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.
v.zh: 神啊，你用东风打破他施的船只。

v.en: The LORD’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.
v.zh: 耶和华的声音使火焰分岔。

v.en: He has built against me, and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.
v.zh: 他筑垒攻击我，用苦楚（原文是苦胆）和艰难围困我。

v.en: I will strengthen them in the LORD. They will walk up and down in his name,” says the LORD.
v.zh: 我必使他们倚靠我，得以坚固；一举一动必奉我的名。这是耶和华说的。

v.en: When the virgins were gathered together the second time, Mordecai was sitting in the king’s gate.
v.zh: 第二次招聚处女的时候，末底改坐在朝门。

v.en: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.
v.zh: 我要承认我的罪孽；我要因我的罪忧愁。

v.en: Gilead is a city of those who work iniquity; it is stained with blood.
v.zh: 基列是作孽之人的城，被血沾染。

v.en: Now David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
v.zh: 耶西的儿子大卫作以色列众人的王，

v.en: so that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men,
v.zh: 甚至他离弃示罗的帐幕，就是他在人间所搭的帐棚；

v.en: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab Hesed, five.
v.zh: 米书兰的儿子是哈舒巴、阿黑、比利家、哈撒底、于沙・希悉，共五人。

v.en: The children of Jorah, one hundred twelve.
v.zh: 约拉的子孙一百一十二名；

v.en: He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations.
v.zh: 落在他们的营中，在他们住处的四面。

v.en: The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats are the price of a field.
v.zh: 羊羔之毛是为你作衣服；山羊是为作田地的价值，

v.en: ‘The LORD bless you, and keep you.
v.zh: 『愿耶和华赐福给你，保护你。

v.en: They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.
v.zh: 他们好像人扬起斧子，砍伐林中的树。

v.zh: 撒但回答耶和华说：「约伯敬畏神，岂是无故呢？

v.en: My beloved spoke, and said to me, “Rise up, my love, my beautiful one, and come away.
v.zh: 我良人对我说：我的佳偶，我的美人，起来，与我同去！

v.en: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions,
v.zh: 立他作王家之主，掌管他一切所有的，

v.en: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither will it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.
v.zh: 黄金和玻璃不足与比较；精金的器皿不足与兑换。

v.en: The children of Adin, four hundred fifty-four.
v.zh: 亚丁的子孙四百五十四名；

v.en: The LORD is a man of war. The LORD is his name.
v.zh: 耶和华是战士；他的名是耶和华。

v.en: the mighty man, the man of war, the judge, the prophet, the diviner, the elder,
v.zh: 除掉勇士和战士，审判官和先知，占卜的和长老，

v.en: The children of Hashum, two hundred twenty-three.
v.zh: 哈顺的子孙二百二十三名；

v.en: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, according to their families.
v.zh: 革顺的儿子按着家室是立尼、示每。

g: to visit, attend to; to muster

v.zh: 但如今因他未曾发怒降罚，也不甚理会狂傲，

v.zh: 你当离恶行善，就可永远安居。

v.en: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.
v.zh: 你以眼泪当食物给他们吃，又多量出眼泪给他们喝。

v.zh: 这是耶和华降罚的时候，因人废了你的律法。

v.zh: 也奉上燔祭，照例而献。

v.zh: 他必有后裔事奉他；主所行的事必传与后代。

v.zh: 他背了约，伸手攻击与他和好的人。

v.zh: 你使我们当作快要被吃的羊，把我们分散在列邦中。

v.zh: 匠人所弃的石头已成了房角的头块石头。

v.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「你手里是甚么？」他说：「是杖。」

v.en: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.
v.zh: 他们的眼睛因体胖而凸出；他们所得的，过于心里所想的。

v.en: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.
v.zh: 神啊，我们在你的殿中想念你的慈爱。

v.zh: 却想不到被脚踹碎，或被野兽践踏。

v.zh: 他满口是咒骂、诡诈、欺压，舌底是毒害、奸恶。

v.en: For the east side eastward fifty cubits,
v.zh: 院子的东面，宽五十肘。

v.en: Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for God?
v.zh: 你们要为神徇情吗？要为他争论吗？

v.en: The LORD will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.
v.zh: 耶和华必拆毁骄傲人的家，却要立定寡妇的地界。

v.zh: 你的始祖犯罪；你的师傅违背我。

v.en: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man—
v.zh: 使愚人灵明，使少年人有知识和谋略，

v.zh: 愿你城中平安！愿你宫内兴旺！

v.en: Increase my honor and comfort me again.
v.zh: 求你使我越发昌大，又转来安慰我。

v.en: that he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.
v.zh: 好叫人不从自己的谋算，不行骄傲的事（原文是将骄傲向人隐藏），

v.en: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,
v.zh: 用十弦的乐器和瑟，用琴弹幽雅的声音，早晨传扬你的慈爱；每夜传扬你的信实。这本为美事。

v.en: who remembered us in our low estate, for his loving kindness endures forever;
v.zh: 他顾念我们在卑微的地步，因他的慈爱永远长存。

v.en: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.
v.zh: 因为你曾以力量束我的腰，使我能争战；你也使那起来攻击我的都服在我以下。

v.en: For that would be a heinous crime. Yes, it would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges,
v.zh: 因为这是大罪，是审判官当罚的罪孽。

v.en: His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.
v.zh: 他必安然居住；他的后裔必承受地土。

v.en: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.
v.zh: 他必有后裔事奉他；主所行的事必传与后代。

v.en: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, wrote.
v.zh: 乌西雅其余的事，自始至终都是亚摩斯的儿子先知以赛亚所记的。

v.en: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.
v.zh: 神啊，我们在你的殿中想念你的慈爱。

v.en: The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.
v.zh: 恶人窥探义人，想要杀他。

v.en: who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.
v.zh: 他们在隐・多珥灭亡，成了地上的粪土。

v.en: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.
v.zh: 我到了所定的日期，必按正直施行审判。

v.en: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.
v.zh: 将他们的地赏赐他的百姓以色列为业。

v.en: Wrap up the covenant. Seal the law among my disciples.
v.zh: 你要卷起律法书，在我门徒中间封住训诲。

v.en: He who robs his father and drives away his mother is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.
v.zh: 虐待父亲、撵出母亲的，是贻羞致辱之子。

g: to be firm, established; to prepare

v.en: By your power, you form the mountains, having armed yourself with strength.
v.zh: 他既以大能束腰，就用力量安定诸山，

v.en: and for the destructive mildew of a garment, and for a house,
v.zh: 并衣服与房子的大麻疯，

v.en: Also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy good in all his labor, is the gift of God.
v.zh: 并且人人吃喝，在他一切劳碌中享福，这也是神的恩赐。

v.en: When you go out and camp against your enemies, then you shall keep yourselves from every evil thing.
v.zh: 「你出兵攻打仇敌，就要远避诸恶。

v.en: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,
v.zh: 他伸手攻击神，以骄傲攻击全能者，

v.en: The children of Bani, six hundred forty-two.
v.zh: 巴尼的子孙六百四十二名；

v.en: When she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and had run outside,
v.zh: 妇人看见约瑟把衣裳丢在她手里跑出去了，

v.en: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,
v.zh: 用十弦的乐器和瑟，用琴弹幽雅的声音，早晨传扬你的慈爱；每夜传扬你的信实。这本为美事。

v.en: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.
v.zh: 要救他们的命脱离死亡，并使他们在饥荒中存活。

v.en: The LORD’s angel solemnly assured Joshua, saying,
v.zh: 耶和华的使者告诫约书亚说：

v.en: “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”
v.zh: 他们说：有怪病贴在他身上；他已躺卧，必不能再起来。

v.en: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.
v.zh: 泰尔的民（原文是女子）必来送礼；民中的富足人也必向你求恩。

v.en: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.
v.zh: 我要在你的命令中自乐；这命令素来是我所爱的。

v.en: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of it to its valuation.
v.zh: 他若一定要赎回，就要在你所估定的价值以外加上五分之一。

v.en: I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.
v.zh: 我向你呼吁，求你救我！我要遵守你的法度。

v.en: The LORD is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.
v.zh: 耶和华有恩惠，有公义；我们的神以怜悯为怀。

v.en: “The harvest is past. The summer has ended, and we are not saved.”
v.zh: 麦秋已过，夏令已完，我们还未得救！

v.en: May the LORD therefore be judge, and give sentence between me and you, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of your hand.”
v.zh: 愿耶和华在你我中间施行审判，断定是非，并且鉴察，为我伸冤，救我脱离你的手。」

v.en: How can I myself alone bear your problems, your burdens, and your strife?
v.zh: 但你们的麻烦，和管理你们的重任，并你们的争讼，我独自一人怎能担当得起呢？

v.en: Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
v.zh: 比利家、以利加拿是约柜前守门的。

v.en: She conceived, bore a son, and said, “God has taken away my reproach.”
v.zh: 拉结怀孕生子，说：「神除去了我的羞耻」，

v.en: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
v.zh: 你要以你的训言引导我，以后必接我到荣耀里。

v.en: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance,
v.zh: 并为公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按数照例，献同献的素祭和同献的奠祭。

v.en: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;
v.zh: 一个金盂，重十舍客勒，盛满了香；

v.en: He could not answer Abner another word, because he was afraid of him.
v.zh: 伊施波设惧怕押尼珥，不敢回答一句。

v.en: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,
v.zh: 我寻得我的仆人大卫，用我的圣膏膏他。

v.en: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.
v.zh: 你是我的神，我要称谢你！你是我的神，我要尊崇你！

v.en: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, and their cords.
v.zh: 院子四围的柱子、带卯的座、橛子，和绳子。

v.en: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
v.zh: 我就要用杖责罚他们的过犯，用鞭责罚他们的罪孽。

v.en: Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?
v.zh: 我们为何算为畜生，在你眼中看作污秽呢？

v.en: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.
v.zh: 你把我的良朋密友隔在远处，使我所认识的人进入黑暗里。

v.en: A revelation about Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
v.zh: 论尼尼微的默示，就是伊勒歌斯人那鸿所得的默示。

v.en: then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,
v.zh: 开通他们的耳朵，将当受的教训印在他们心上，

g: to uncover; to go into exile

v.en: The hay is removed, and the new growth appears, the grasses of the hills are gathered in.
v.zh: 干草割去，嫩草发现，山上的菜蔬也被收敛。

v.en: Abraham said, “I will swear.”
v.zh: 亚伯拉罕说：「我情愿起誓。」

v.en: I said, “My strength has perished, along with my expectation from the LORD.”
v.zh: 我就说：我的力量衰败；我在耶和华那里毫无指望！

v.en: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.
v.zh: 谨守诫命的，保全生命；轻忽己路的，必致死亡。

v.en: that you may be accepted, you shall offer a male without defect, of the bulls, of the sheep, or of the goats.
v.zh: 要将没有残疾的公牛，或是绵羊，或是山羊献上，如此方蒙悦纳。

v.en: A glorious throne, set on high from the beginning, is the place of our sanctuary.
v.zh: 我们的圣所是荣耀的宝座，从太初安置在高处。

v.en: So Job died, being old and full of days.
v.zh: 这样，约伯年纪老迈，日子满足而死。

v.en: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages.
v.zh: 该隐、基比亚、亭纳，共十座城，还有属城的村庄。

v.en: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.
v.zh: 他们围绕我，说怨恨的话，又无故地攻打我。

v.en: He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.
v.zh: 他废去忠信人的讲论，又夺去老人的聪明。

v.en: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.
v.zh: 他们一求，他就使鹌鹑飞来，并用天上的粮食叫他们饱足。

v.en: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite (a chief of the Reubenites), and thirty with him,
v.zh: 流便人示撒的儿子亚第拿〈他是流便支派中的一个族长，率领三十人〉，

v.en: The man bowed his head, and worshiped the LORD.
v.zh: 那人就低头向耶和华下拜，

v.en: “Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.
v.zh: 「当记念安息日，守为圣日。

v.en: When you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you;
v.zh: 你若与官长坐席，要留意在你面前的是谁。

v.en: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.
v.zh: 他打发他的仆人摩西和他所拣选的亚伦，

v.en: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.
v.zh: 他必有后裔事奉他；主所行的事必传与后代。

v.en: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters,
v.zh: 在海上坐船，在大水中经理事务的，

v.en: He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings—
v.zh: 他击杀许多的民，又杀戮大能的王，

v.en: The men of the other Nebo: fifty-two.
v.zh: 别的尼波人五十二名；

v.en: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.
v.zh: 我要自由而行（或译：我要行在宽阔之地），因我素来考究你的训词。

v.en: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.
v.zh: 愿我的性命存活，得以赞美你！愿你的典章帮助我！

v.en: He put up the screen of the door to the tabernacle.
v.zh: 又挂上帐幕的门帘。

v.en: There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.
v.zh: 有人挪移地界，抢夺群畜而牧养。

v.en: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.
v.zh: 智慧在街市上呼喊，在宽阔处发声，

v.en: The men of Netophah, fifty-six.
v.zh: 尼陀法人五十六名；

v.en: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on the LORD’s name.
v.zh: 我要以感谢为祭献给你，又要求告耶和华的名。

v.en: Whoever carries any part of their carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening.
v.zh: 凡拿了死的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服。

v.en: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.
v.zh: 他必有后裔事奉他；主所行的事必传与后代。

v.en: Damascus has grown feeble, she turns herself to flee, and trembling has seized her. Anguish and sorrows have taken hold of her, as of a woman in travail.
v.zh: 大马士革发软，转身逃跑。战兢将她捉住；痛苦忧愁将她抓住，如产难的妇人一样。

v.en: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.
v.zh: 少年时所生的儿女好像勇士手中的箭。

v.en: He believed in the LORD, who credited it to him for righteousness.
v.zh: 亚伯兰信耶和华，耶和华就以此为他的义。

v.en: so that my soul chooses strangling, death rather than my bones.
v.zh: 甚至我宁肯噎死，宁肯死亡，胜似留我这一身的骨头。

v.en: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.
v.zh: 又转到西面，用竿量五百肘。

v.en: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.
v.zh: 他们出来的时候，埃及人便欢喜；原来埃及人惧怕他们。

v.en: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a second son.
v.zh: 利亚的使女悉帕又给雅各生了第二个儿子。

v.en: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, twenty boards,
v.zh: 帐幕第二面，就是北面，也要做板二十块

v.en: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
v.zh: 至于那些昂首围困我的人，愿他们嘴唇的奸恶陷害（原文是遮蔽）自己！

v.en: Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!
v.zh: 要因他大能的作为赞美他，按着他极美的大德赞美他！

v.en: Saul also went to his house in Gibeah; and the army went with him, whose hearts God had touched.
v.zh: 扫罗往基比亚回家去，有神感动的一群人跟随他。

v.en: With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.
v.zh: 年老的有智慧；寿高的有知识。

v.en: I have come to the brink of utter ruin, among the gathered assembly.”
v.zh: 我在圣会里，几乎落在诸般恶中。

v.en: The LORD has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers,
v.zh: 耶和华折断了恶人的杖，辖制人的圭，

v.en: There are six things which the LORD hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:
v.zh: 耶和华所恨恶的有六样，连他心所憎恶的共有七样：

v.en: Arise! Let’s go up by night, and let’s destroy her palaces.”
v.zh: 起来吧，我们夜间上去，毁坏她的宫殿。

v.en: The standard of the camp of Reuben went forward according to their armies. Elizur the son of Shedeur was over his army.
v.zh: 按着军队往前行的是流便营的纛。统领军队的是示丢珥的儿子以利蓿。

v.en: You shall do no regular work. You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.’”
v.zh: 甚么劳碌的工都不可做；要将火祭献给耶和华。」

v.en: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.
v.zh: 他打开磐石，水就涌出；在干旱之处，水流成河。

v.en: For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead.
v.zh: 原来仇敌逼迫我，将我打倒在地，使我住在幽暗之处，像死了许久的人一样。

v.en: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.
v.zh: 因为我困苦穷乏，内心受伤。

v.en: Woe to Ariel! Ariel, the city where David encamped! Add year to year; let the feasts come around;
v.zh: 唉！亚利伊勒，亚利伊勒，大卫安营的城，任凭你年上加年，节期照常周流。

v.en: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.
v.zh: 不可偏向左右；要使你的脚离开邪恶。

v.en: Prostitution, wine, and new wine take away understanding.
v.zh: 奸淫和酒，并新酒，夺去人的心。

v.en: From there they traveled, and encamped in the valley of Zered.
v.zh: 从那里起行，安营在撒烈谷。

v.en: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
v.zh: 雅各的神啊，你的斥责一发，坐车的、骑马的都沉睡了。

v.en: Can one break iron, even iron from the north, and bronze?
v.zh: （人岂能将铜与铁，就是北方的铁折断呢？）

v.en: He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations.
v.zh: 落在他们的营中，在他们住处的四面。

v.en: A wise man’s heart is at his right hand, but a fool’s heart at his left.
v.zh: 智慧人的心居右；愚昧人的心居左。

v.en: The children of Azmaveth, forty-two.
v.zh: 亚斯玛弗人四十二名；

v.en: Also, Solomon sits on the throne of the kingdom.
v.zh: 并且所罗门登了国位。

v.en: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
v.zh: 他垂听穷人的祷告，并不藐视他们的祈求。

v.en: “You shall not blaspheme God, nor curse a ruler of your people.
v.zh: 「不可毁谤神；也不可毁谤你百姓的官长。

v.en: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.
v.zh: 当时，他们人丁有限，数目稀少，并且在那地为寄居的。

v.en: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in the LORD.
v.zh: 当献上公义的祭，又当倚靠耶和华。

v.en: They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.
v.zh: 他们晚上转回，叫号如狗，围城绕行。

v.en: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.
v.zh: 你安置月亮为定节令；日头自知沉落。

v.en: Jair died, and was buried in Kamon.
v.zh: 睚珥死了，就葬在加们。

v.en: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”
v.zh: 你们对答的话中既都错谬，怎么徒然安慰我呢？

v.en: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;
v.zh: 一只公牛犊，一只公绵羊，一只一岁的公羊羔作燔祭；

v.en: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.
v.zh: 富足人的财物是他的坚城，在他心想，犹如高墙。

v.en: Then justice will dwell in the wilderness; and righteousness will remain in the fruitful field.
v.zh: 那时，公平要居在旷野；公义要居在肥田。

v.en: and confirmed it to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
v.zh: 他又将这约向雅各定为律例，向以色列定为永远的约，

v.en: and gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.
v.zh: 从各地，从东从西，从南从北，所招聚来的。

v.en: the gecko, and the monitor lizard, the wall lizard, the skink, and the chameleon.
v.zh: 壁虎、龙子、守宫、蛇医、蝘蜓。

v.en: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.
v.zh: 他要报应我仇敌所行的恶；求你凭你的诚实灭绝他们。

v.en: In the same day both Abraham and Ishmael, his son, were circumcised.
v.zh: 正当那日，亚伯拉罕和他儿子以实玛利一同受了割礼。

v.en: Then the servants came near with their children, and they bowed themselves.
v.zh: 于是两个使女和她们的孩子前来下拜；

v.en: The steps of his strength will be shortened. His own counsel will cast him down.
v.zh: 他坚强的脚步必见狭窄；自己的计谋必将他绊倒。

v.en: The highways are desolate. The traveling man ceases. The covenant is broken. He has despised the cities. He doesn’t respect man.
v.zh: 大路荒凉，行人止息；敌人背约，藐视城邑，不顾人民。

v.en: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.
v.zh: 当止住怒气，离弃忿怒；不要心怀不平，以致作恶。

v.en: You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its width.
v.zh: 要用精金做施恩座（施恩：或译蔽罪；下同），长二肘半，宽一肘半。

v.en: I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.
v.zh: 我要将你的名传与我的弟兄，在会中我要赞美你。

v.en: He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.
v.zh: 他叫有智慧的中了自己的诡计，使狡诈人的计谋速速灭亡。

v.en: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.
v.zh: 他要使你的公义如光发出，使你的公平明如正午。

v.en: The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.
v.zh: 她丈夫心里倚靠她，必不缺少利益；

v.en: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
v.zh: 雅各的神啊，你的斥责一发，坐车的、骑马的都沉睡了。

v.en: We have a little sister. She has no breasts. What shall we do for our sister in the day when she is to be spoken for?
v.zh: 我们有一小妹；她的两乳尚未长成，人来提亲的日子，我们当为她怎样办理？

v.en: The waters will fail from the sea, and the river will be wasted and become dry.
v.zh: 海中的水必绝尽，河也消没干涸。

v.en: You are righteous, LORD. Your judgments are upright.
v.zh: 耶和华啊，你是公义的；你的判语也是正直的！

v.en: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.
v.zh: 但你是圣洁的，是用以色列的赞美为宝座（或译：居所）的。

v.en: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.
v.zh: 所以必吃自结的果子，充满自设的计谋。

v.en: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.
v.zh: 他要按公义审判你的民，按公平审判你的困苦人。

v.en: Of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.
v.zh: 示罗的子孙中有长子亚帅雅和他的众子。

v.en: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.
v.zh: 有时在街市上，有时在宽阔处，或在各巷口蹲伏，

v.en: You shall not eat any abominable thing.
v.zh: 「凡可憎的物都不可吃。

v.en: The fat of the sin offering he shall burn on the altar.
v.zh: 赎罪祭牲的脂油要在坛上焚烧。

v.en: The meat and the skin he burned with fire outside the camp.
v.zh: 又用火将肉和皮烧在营外。

v.en: At the instant I speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it,
v.zh: 我何时论到一邦或一国说，要建立、栽植；

v.en: The LORD has accomplished his wrath. He has poured out his fierce anger. He has kindled a fire in Zion, which has devoured its foundations.
v.zh: 耶和华发怒成就他所定的，倒出他的烈怒；在锡安使火着起，烧毁锡安的根基。

v.en: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.
v.zh: 能保你远离恶妇，远离外女谄媚的舌头。

v.en: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”
v.zh: 并要在患难之日求告我；我必搭救你，你也要荣耀我。

v.en: Oh magnify the LORD with me. Let’s exalt his name together.
v.zh: 你们和我当称耶和华为大，一同高举他的名。

g: to repay, make whole; be at peace

v.en: You will make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You will pay your vows.
v.zh: 你要祷告他，他就听你；你也要还你的愿。

v.en: He fell on his brother Benjamin’s neck and wept, and Benjamin wept on his neck.
v.zh: 于是约瑟伏在他兄弟便雅悯的颈项上哭，便雅悯也在他的颈项上哭。

v.en: At the sound of the cry of your pilots, the pasture lands will shake.
v.zh: 你掌舵的呼号之声一发，郊野都必震动。

v.en: When he had finished prophesying, he came to the high place.
v.zh: 扫罗受感说话已毕，就上邱坛去了。

v.en: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.
v.zh: 你是我的神，我要称谢你！你是我的神，我要尊崇你！

v.en: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.
v.zh: 惟你救了我们脱离敌人，使恨我们的人羞愧。

v.en: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.
v.zh: 谎话是我所恨恶所憎嫌的；惟你的律法是我所爱的。

v.en: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.
v.zh: 他在云柱中对他们说话；他们遵守他的法度和他所赐给他们的律例。

v.en: When Moses heard that, it was pleasing in his sight.
v.zh: 摩西听见这话，便以为美。

v.en: He made the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.
v.zh: 帐幕的南面做板二十块。

v.en: “Observe the Sabbath day, to keep it holy, as the LORD your God commanded you.
v.zh: 「『当照耶和华―你神所吩咐的守安息日为圣日。

v.en: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust. My skin closes up, and breaks out afresh.
v.zh: 我的肉体以虫子和尘土为衣；我的皮肤才收了口又重新破裂。

v.en: wild animals and all livestock, small creatures and flying birds,
v.zh: 野兽和一切牲畜，昆虫和飞鸟，

v.en: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.
v.zh: 我遭遇患难愁苦，你的命令却是我所喜爱的。

v.en: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!
v.zh: 我的性命几乎归于尘土；求你照你的话将我救活！

v.en: The children of Zattu: eight hundred forty-five.
v.zh: 萨土的子孙八百四十五名；

v.en: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.
v.zh: 有晚上，有早晨，是第三日。

v.en: Increase my honor and comfort me again.
v.zh: 求你使我越发昌大，又转来安慰我。

v.en: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.
v.zh: 那时，他们才信了他的话，歌唱赞美他。

v.en: What remains of the meat and of the bread you shall burn with fire.
v.zh: 剩下的肉和饼，你们要用火焚烧。

v.en: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;
v.zh: 为那七只羊羔，每只要献伊法十分之一。

v.en: You shall therefore keep this ordinance in its season from year to year.
v.zh: 所以你每年要按着日期守这例。』」

v.en: Break out into joy! Sing together, you waste places of Jerusalem; for the LORD has comforted his people. He has redeemed Jerusalem.
v.zh: 耶路撒冷的荒场啊，要发起欢声，一同歌唱；因为耶和华安慰了他的百姓，救赎了耶路撒冷。

v.en: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can’t see. Let their backs be continually bent.
v.zh: 愿他们的眼睛昏蒙，不得看见；愿你使他们的腰常常战抖。

v.en: When he had finished prophesying, he came to the high place.
v.zh: 扫罗受感说话已毕，就上邱坛去了。

v.en: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.
v.zh: 太阳如同新郎出洞房，又如勇士欢然奔路。

v.en: Leah’s eyes were weak, but Rachel was beautiful in form and attractive.
v.zh: 利亚的眼睛没有神气，拉结却生得美貌俊秀。

v.en: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.
v.zh: 并献一只公山羊作赎罪祭，为你们赎罪。

v.en: He said, “Please, my brothers, don’t act so wickedly.
v.zh: 说：「众弟兄，请你们不要做这恶事。

v.en: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah and his good deeds, according to that which is written in the LORD’s law,
v.zh: 约西亚其余的事和他遵着耶和华律法上所记而行的善事，

v.en: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?” Selah.
v.zh: 难道神忘记开恩，因发怒就止住他的慈悲吗？（细拉）

v.en: Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Mica. All who lived in Ziba’s house were servants to Mephibosheth.
v.zh: 米非波设有一个小儿子，名叫米迦。凡住在洗巴家里的人都作了米非波设的仆人。

v.en: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.
v.zh: 一个义人所有的虽少，强过许多恶人的富余。

v.en: The famine was severe in the land.
v.zh: 那地的饥荒甚大。

v.en: The width of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
v.zh: 院子的东面要宽五十肘。

v.en: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!
v.zh: 我虽然无过，他们预备整齐，跑来攻击我。求你兴起鉴察，帮助我！

v.en: You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.
v.zh: 你以皮和肉为衣给我穿上，用骨与筋把我全体联络。

v.en: Ozem the sixth, and David the seventh;
v.zh: 六子阿鲜，七子大卫。

v.en: He makes his messengers winds, and his servants flames of fire.
v.zh: 以风为使者，以火焰为仆役，

g: to sojourn, dwell as a foreigner

v.en: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid. They retreat before his thrashing.
v.zh: 它一起来，勇士都惊恐，心里慌乱，便都昏迷。

v.en: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
v.zh: 大卫年纪老迈，日子满足，就立他儿子所罗门作以色列的王。

v.en: They took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.
v.zh: 他们从疏割起行，在旷野边的以倘安营。

v.en: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless, and they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.
v.zh: 他们拉去孤儿的驴，强取寡妇的牛为当头。

v.en: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.
v.zh: 他发命医治他们，救他们脱离死亡。

v.en: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”
v.zh: 我要使他足享长寿，将我的救恩显明给他。

v.en: When the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.
v.zh: 日落的时候，他就洁净了，然后可以吃圣物，因为这是他的食物。

v.en: The slain will fall among you, and you will know that I am the LORD.
v.zh: 被杀的人必倒在你们中间，你们就知道我是耶和华。

v.en: Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.
v.zh: 求你使我得听欢喜快乐的声音，使你所压伤的骨头可以踊跃。

v.en: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.
v.zh: 使敌人的心转去恨他的百姓，并用诡计待他的仆人。

v.en: Of all clean birds you may eat.
v.zh: 凡洁净的鸟，你们都可以吃。

v.en: At the brightness before him, coals of fire were kindled.
v.zh: 因他面前的光辉炭都着了。

v.en: Thus they were defiled with their works, and prostituted themselves in their deeds.
v.zh: 这样，他们被自己所做的污秽了，在行为上犯了邪淫。

v.en: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man—
v.zh: 使愚人灵明，使少年人有知识和谋略，

v.en: By David. A contemplative psalm. Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
v.zh: （大卫的训诲诗。）得赦免其过、遮盖其罪的，这人是有福的！

v.en: From beyond the rivers of Cush, my worshipers, even the daughter of my dispersed people, will bring my offering.
v.zh: 祈祷我的，就是我所分散的民（原文是女子；下同），必从古实河外来，给我献供物。

v.en: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.
v.zh: 许多人以我为怪，但你是我坚固的避难所。

v.en: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.
v.zh: 我是在地上作寄居的；求你不要向我隐瞒你的命令！

v.en: In that day, sing to her, “A pleasant vineyard!
v.zh: 当那日，有出酒的葡萄园，你们要指这园唱歌说：

v.en: They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.
v.zh: 他们的心被脂油包裹；他们用口说骄傲的话。

v.en: A song. A Psalm by Asaph.
v.zh: （亚萨的诗歌。）

v.en: The LORD has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.
v.zh: 耶和华在天上立定宝座；他的权柄（原文是国）统管万有。

v.en: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.
v.zh: 他坐着基路伯飞行；他藉着风的翅膀快飞。

v.en: seventy-two thousand head of cattle,
v.zh: 牛七万二千只；

v.en: Lot went out to them through the door, and shut the door after himself.
v.zh: 罗得出来，把门关上，到众人那里，

v.en: From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.
v.zh: 亮光不照恶人；强横的膀臂也必折断。

v.en: You shall be blameless with the LORD your God.
v.zh: 你要在耶和华―你的神面前作完全人。」

v.en: I will uproot your Asherah poles from among you; and I will destroy your cities.
v.zh: 我必从你中间拔出木偶，又毁灭你的城邑。

v.en: “With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding.
v.zh: 在神有智慧和能力；他有谋略和知识。

v.en: The LORD said, “Is it right for you to be angry?”
v.zh: 耶和华说：「你这样发怒合乎理吗？」

v.en: Better is a poor and wise youth than an old and foolish king who doesn’t know how to receive admonition any more.
v.zh: 贫穷而有智慧的少年人胜过年老不肯纳谏的愚昧王。

v.en: Lot went out to them through the door, and shut the door after himself.
v.zh: 罗得出来，把门关上，到众人那里，

v.en: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.
v.zh: 那时，他们才信了他的话，歌唱赞美他。

v.en: and of cassia five hundred, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; and a hin of olive oil.
v.zh: 桂皮五百舍客勒，都按着圣所的平，又取橄榄油一欣，

v.en: All winged creeping things are unclean to you. They shall not be eaten.
v.zh: 凡有翅膀爬行的物是与你们不洁净，都不可吃。

v.en: Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet he will not learn righteousness. In the land of uprightness he will deal wrongfully, and will not see the LORD’s majesty.
v.zh: 以恩惠待恶人，他仍不学习公义；在正直的地上，他必行事不义，也不注意耶和华的威严。

g: to lodge, spend the night; to grumble

v.en: She said moreover to him, “We have both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge in.”
v.zh: 又说：「我们家里足有粮草，也有住宿的地方。」

v.en: Yes, though you offer me your burnt offerings and meal offerings, I will not accept them; neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat animals.
v.zh: 你们虽然向我献燔祭和素祭，我却不悦纳，也不顾你们用肥畜献的平安祭；

v.en: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever.
v.zh: 我因学你的法度，久已知道是你永远立定的。

v.en: You have covered yourself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.
v.zh: 你以黑云遮蔽自己，以致祷告不得透入。

v.en: What were its foundations fastened on? Or who laid its cornerstone,
v.zh: 地的根基安置在何处？地的角石是谁安放的？

v.en: the field which Abraham purchased from the children of Heth. Abraham was buried there with Sarah, his wife.
v.zh: 就是亚伯拉罕向赫人买的那块田。亚伯拉罕和他妻子撒拉都葬在那里。

v.en: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.
v.zh: 所以，我的灵在我里面发昏；我的心在我里面凄惨。

v.en: Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.
v.zh: 要将你的珍宝丢在尘土里，将俄斐的黄金丢在溪河石头之间；

v.en: For the east side eastward fifty cubits,
v.zh: 院子的东面，宽五十肘。

v.en: The LORD is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.
v.zh: 耶和华远离恶人，却听义人的祷告。

v.en: At the noise of the thunder, the peoples have fled. When you lift yourself up, the nations are scattered.
v.zh: 喧嚷的响声一发，众民奔逃；你一兴起，列国四散。

v.en: Then Phinehas stood up and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.
v.zh: 那时，非尼哈站起，刑罚恶人，瘟疫这才止息。

v.en: They break your people in pieces, LORD, and afflict your heritage.
v.zh: 耶和华啊，他们强压你的百姓，苦害你的产业。

v.en: He shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.
v.zh: 祭司既在民中为首，就不可从俗沾染自己。

v.en: Help me, LORD, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;
v.zh: 耶和华―我的神啊，求你帮助我，照你的慈爱拯救我，

v.en: A mighty king will stand up, who will rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.
v.zh: 必有一个勇敢的王兴起，执掌大权，随意而行。

v.en: “Anyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.
v.zh: 「咒骂父母的，必要把他治死。

v.en: that you may be accepted, you shall offer a male without defect, of the bulls, of the sheep, or of the goats.
v.zh: 要将没有残疾的公牛，或是绵羊，或是山羊献上，如此方蒙悦纳。

v.en: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.
v.zh: 谁能知道自己的错失呢？愿你赦免我隐而未现的过错。

v.en: He shall kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.
v.zh: 用瓦器盛活水，把一只鸟宰在上面，

v.en: “‘If his offering is a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD.
v.zh: 「人的供物若是山羊，必在耶和华面前献上。

v.en: He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in hiding.
v.zh: 他向我如熊埋伏，如狮子在隐密处。

v.en: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.
v.zh: 琴瑟啊，你们当醒起！我自己要极早醒起！

v.en: The temple and the sanctuary had two doors.
v.zh: 殿和至圣所的门各有两扇。

v.en: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.
v.zh: 在他们以先打发一个人去―约瑟被卖为奴仆。

v.en: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.
v.zh: 他从黑暗中和死荫里领他们出来，折断他们的绑索。

v.en: Better is little, with the fear of the LORD, than great treasure with trouble.
v.zh: 少有财宝，敬畏耶和华，强如多有财宝，烦乱不安。

v.en: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have plotted evil against you, saying,
v.zh: 因为亚兰和以法莲，并利玛利的儿子，设恶谋害你，

v.en: You shall not muzzle the ox when he treads out the grain.
v.zh: 「牛在场上踹谷的时候，不可笼住它的嘴。」

v.en: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.
v.zh: 至于我，却要行事纯全；求你救赎我，怜恤我！

v.en: They will be for a sign and for a wonder to you and to your offspring forever.
v.zh: 这些咒诅必在你和你后裔的身上成为异迹奇事，直到永远！

v.en: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.
v.zh: 求你救我脱离作孽的人和喜爱流人血的人！

v.en: You frustrate the plan of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.
v.zh: 你们叫困苦人的谋算变为羞辱；然而耶和华是他的避难所。

v.en: They cast lots for their offices, all alike, the small as well as the great, the teacher as well as the student.
v.zh: 这些人无论大小，为师的、为徒的，都一同掣签分了班次。

v.en: Oh come, let’s sing to the LORD. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!
v.zh: 来啊，我们要向耶和华歌唱，向拯救我们的磐石欢呼！

v.en: You are near, LORD. All your commandments are truth.
v.zh: 耶和华啊，你与我相近；你一切的命令尽都真实！

v.en: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.
v.zh: 把我提在风中，使我驾风而行，又使我消灭在烈风中。

v.en: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.
v.zh: 他必受伤损，必被凌辱；他的羞耻不得涂抹。

v.en: The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.
v.zh: 掣签能止息争竞，也能解散强胜的人。

v.en: Therefore with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation.
v.zh: 所以，你们必从救恩的泉源欢然取水。

v.en: They moved him to jealousy with strange gods. They provoked him to anger with abominations.
v.zh: 敬拜别神，触动神的愤恨，行可憎恶的事，惹了他的怒气。

v.en: A prayer of Habakkuk, the prophet, set to victorious music.
v.zh: 先知哈巴谷的祷告，调用流离歌。

v.zh: 不可偏向左右；要使你的脚离开邪恶。

v.en: The tongue of the nursing child clings to the roof of his mouth for thirst. The young children ask for bread, and no one breaks it for them.
v.zh: 吃奶孩子的舌头因干渴贴住上膛；孩童求饼，无人擘给他们。

v.en: But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.
v.zh: 无奈，我的民不听我的声音；以色列全不理我。

v.en: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.
v.zh: 披上亮光，如披外袍，铺张穹苍，如铺幔子，

v.en: who build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.
v.zh: 以人血建立锡安，以罪孽建造耶路撒冷。

v.en: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”
v.zh: 他也必拿上好的麦子给他们吃，又拿从磐石出的蜂蜜叫他们饱足。

v.en: A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.
v.zh: 智慧人惧怕，就远离恶事；愚妄人却狂傲自恃。

v.en: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
v.zh: 起初，神创造天地。

v.en: “The harvest is past. The summer has ended, and we are not saved.”
v.zh: 麦秋已过，夏令已完，我们还未得救！

v.en: You shall make them linen pants to cover their naked flesh. They shall reach from the waist even to the thighs.
v.zh: 要给他们做细麻布裤子，遮掩下体；裤子当从腰达到大腿。

v.en: But you, LORD, are on high forever more.
v.zh: 惟你―耶和华是至高，直到永远。

v.en: Those who regard vain idols forsake their own mercy.
v.zh: 那信奉虚无之神的人，离弃怜爱他们的主；

v.en: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.
v.zh: 我要因你欢喜快乐；至高者啊，我要歌颂你的名！

v.en: If your offering is a meal offering of the pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
v.zh: 若用煎盘做的物为素祭，就要用油与细面做成。

v.en: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’
v.zh: 我的荣耀在身上增新；我的弓在手中日强。

v.en: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy!
v.zh: 愿你的祭司披上公义！愿你的圣民欢呼！

v.en: If your offering is a meal offering made on a griddle, it shall be of unleavened fine flour, mixed with oil.
v.zh: 若用铁鏊上做的物为素祭，就要用调油的无酵细面，

g: to bind up; to be hostile

v.en: The wind has wrapped her up in its wings; and they shall be disappointed because of their sacrifices.
v.zh: 风把他们裹在翅膀里；他们因所献的祭必致蒙羞。

v.en: Then the nations attacked him on every side from the provinces. They spread their net over him. He was taken in their pit.
v.zh: 于是四围邦国各省的人来攻击它，将网撒在它身上，捉在他们的坑中。

g: to devote to destruction; to ban

v.en: “He who sacrifices to any god, except to the LORD only, shall be utterly destroyed.
v.zh: 「祭祀别神，不单单祭祀耶和华的，那人必要灭绝。

v.en: The priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand.
v.zh: 祭司要从那一罗革油中取些倒在自己的左手掌里，

v.en: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.
v.zh: 你那里若有现成的，不可对邻舍说：去吧，明天再来，我必给你。

v.en: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.
v.zh: 淫妇用许多巧言诱他随从，用谄媚的嘴逼他同行。

v.en: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.
v.zh: 他将海分裂，使他们过去，又叫水立起如垒。

v.en: In that day, the LORD of Armies will become a crown of glory and a diadem of beauty to the residue of his people,
v.zh: 到那日，万军之耶和华必作他余剩之民的荣冠华冕，

v.en: then you scare me with dreams and terrify me through visions,
v.zh: 你就用梦惊骇我，用异象恐吓我，

v.en: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.
v.zh: 能力和威仪是她的衣服；她想到日后的景况就喜笑。

v.en: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.
v.zh: 义人必承受地土，永居其上。

v.en: He brought me to the north gate, and he measured it according to these measurements—
v.zh: 他带我到北门，就照先前的尺寸量那门，

v.en: Of the first of your dough, you shall give to the LORD a wave offering throughout your generations.
v.zh: 你们世世代代要用初熟的麦子磨面，当举祭献给耶和华。

v.en: For the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket is too narrow to wrap oneself in.
v.zh: 原来，床榻短，使人不能舒身；被窝窄，使人不能遮体。

v.en: My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me.
v.zh: 我心慌张，惊恐威吓我。我所羡慕的黄昏，变为我的战兢。

v.en: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.
v.zh: 求你将我的罪孽洗除净尽，并洁除我的罪！

v.en: The revelation which Habakkuk the prophet saw.
v.zh: 先知哈巴谷所得的默示。

v.en: You shall make twenty boards for the tabernacle, for the south side southward.
v.zh: 帐幕的南面要做板二十块。

v.en: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.
v.zh: 在无人居住之处刨开矿穴，过路的人也想不到他们；又与人远离，悬在空中摇来摇去。

v.en: A Song of Ascents. Out of the depths I have cried to you, LORD.
v.zh: （上行之诗。）耶和华啊，我从深处向你求告！

v.en: There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.
v.zh: 有人挪移地界，抢夺群畜而牧养。

v.en: “I made a covenant with my eyes; how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?
v.zh: 我与眼睛立约，怎能恋恋瞻望处女呢？

v.en: A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors evil in his heart.
v.zh: 怨恨人的，用嘴粉饰，心里却藏着诡诈；

v.en: It is time to act, LORD, for they break your law.
v.zh: 这是耶和华降罚的时候，因人废了你的律法。

v.en: He has swallowed down riches, and he will vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly.
v.zh: 他吞了财宝，还要吐出；神要从他腹中掏出来。

v.en: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.
v.zh: 要听教训就得智慧，不可弃绝。

v.en: the signet rings, the nose rings,
v.zh: 戒指、鼻环、

v.en: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.
v.zh: 我拣选了忠信的道，将你的典章摆在我面前。

g: for the sake of, because of (בַּעֲבוּר)

v.en: “Therefore my thoughts answer me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.
v.zh: 我心中急躁，所以我的思念叫我回答。

v.en: Terror and the pit have come on us, devastation and destruction.”
v.zh: 恐惧和陷坑，残害和毁灭，都临近我们。

v.en: “You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
v.zh: 「你要做以弗得的外袍，颜色全是蓝的。

g: to strike, smite; to be defeated

v.en: The LORD will strike Egypt, striking and healing. They will return to the LORD, and he will be entreated by them, and will heal them.
v.zh: 耶和华必击打埃及，又击打又医治，埃及人就归向耶和华。他必应允他们的祷告，医治他们。

v.en: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.
v.zh: 要为风定轻重，又度量诸水；

v.en: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.
v.zh: 也不怕黑夜行的瘟疫，或是午间灭人的毒病。

v.en: for every lofty tower, for every fortified wall,
v.zh: 又临到高台和坚固城墙；

v.en: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.
v.zh: 我如日影渐渐偏斜而去；我如蝗虫被抖出来。

v.en: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were twisted like a deceitful bow.
v.zh: 反倒退后，行诡诈，像他们的祖宗一样；他们改变，如同翻背的弓。

v.en: “You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
v.zh: 「你要做以弗得的外袍，颜色全是蓝的。

v.en: “‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the LORD’s Passover.
v.zh: 「正月十四日是耶和华的逾越节。

v.en: Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.
v.zh: 骄傲在败坏以先；狂心在跌倒之前。

v.en: Give ear to my words, LORD. Consider my meditation.
v.zh: 耶和华啊，求你留心听我的言语，顾念我的心思！

v.en: I have waited for your salvation, LORD.
v.zh: 耶和华啊，我向来等候你的救恩。

v.en: A room with its door was by the posts at the gates. They washed the burnt offering there.
v.zh: 门洞的柱旁有屋子和门；祭司（原文是他们）在那里洗燔祭牲。

v.en: The quiver rattles against him, the flashing spear and the javelin.
v.zh: 箭袋和发亮的枪，并短枪在它身上铮铮有声。

g: to take one's stand, present oneself

v.en: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.
v.zh: 你若回答我，就站起来，在我面前陈明。

v.en: I clothe the heavens with blackness. I make sackcloth their covering.”
v.zh: 我使诸天以黑暗为衣服，以麻布为遮盖。

v.en: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
v.zh: 你的话是我脚前的灯，是我路上的光。

v.en: The LORD said, “I have pardoned according to your word;
v.zh: 耶和华说：「我照着你的话赦免了他们。

v.en: He shall not eat that which dies of itself or is torn by animals, defiling himself by it. I am the LORD.
v.zh: 自死的或是被野兽撕裂的，他不可吃，因此污秽自己。我是耶和华。

v.en: Your altars will become desolate, and your incense altars will be broken. I will cast down your slain men before your idols.
v.zh: 你们的祭坛必然荒凉，你们的日像必被打碎。我要使你们被杀的人倒在你们的偶像面前；

v.en: He struck them hip and thigh with a great slaughter; and he went down and lived in the cave in Etam’s rock.
v.zh: 参孙就大大击杀他们，连腿带腰都砍断了。他便下去，住在以坦磐的穴内。

v.en: Shall the plunder be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captives be delivered?
v.zh: 勇士抢去的岂能夺回？该掳掠的岂能解救吗？

v.en: He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
v.zh: 他要按手在燔祭牲的头上，燔祭便蒙悦纳，为他赎罪。

v.en: He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.
v.zh: 他也使他们在凡掳掠他们的人面前蒙怜恤。

v.en: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.
v.zh: 你从埃及挪出一棵葡萄树，赶出外邦人，把这树栽上。

v.en: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.
v.zh: 你使我们进入网罗，把重担放在我们的身上。

v.en: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.
v.zh: 又用金子包裹二基路伯。

v.en: I love you, LORD, my strength.
v.zh: 耶和华，我的力量啊，我爱你！

v.en: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
v.zh: 他用美物使你所愿的得以知足，以致你如鹰返老还童。

v.en: “You shall not murder.
v.zh: 「『不可杀人。

v.en: So the poor has hope, and injustice shuts her mouth.
v.zh: 这样，贫寒的人有指望，罪孽之辈必塞口无言。

g: sheep, lamb; one of a flock

v.en: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.
v.zh: 我如亡羊走迷了路，求你寻找仆人，因我不忘记你的命令。

g: to restrain, hold back, shut up

v.en: Then Phinehas stood up and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.
v.zh: 那时，非尼哈站起，刑罚恶人，瘟疫这才止息。

v.en: My soul shall be joyful in the LORD. It shall rejoice in his salvation.
v.zh: 我的心必靠耶和华快乐，靠他的救恩高兴。

g: to sink, relax; to let go, abandon

v.en: If you falter in the time of trouble, your strength is small.
v.zh: 你在患难之日若胆怯，你的力量就微小。

v.en: “He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,
v.zh: 人在床上被惩治，骨头中不住地疼痛，

v.en: Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
v.zh: 雅各仍旧行路，神的使者遇见他。

v.en: He made them a feast, and they ate and drank.
v.zh: 以撒就为他们设摆筵席，他们便吃了喝了。

v.en: This, your stature, is like a palm tree, your breasts like its fruit.
v.zh: 你的身量好像棕树；你的两乳如同其上的果子，累累下垂。

v.en: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our houses to aliens.
v.zh: 我们的产业归与外邦人；我们的房屋归与外路人。

v.en: It is a trespass offering. He is certainly guilty before the LORD.”
v.zh: 这是赎愆祭，因他在耶和华面前实在有了罪。」

v.en: With you I will break in pieces the chariot and him who rides therein. With you I will break in pieces man and woman. With you I will break in pieces the old man and the youth. With you I will break in pieces the young man and the virgin.
v.zh: 用你打碎男人和女人；用你打碎老年人和少年人；用你打碎壮丁和处女；

v.en: Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.
v.zh: 神啊，求你听我的呼求，侧耳听我的祷告！

v.en: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
v.zh: 四子拿坦业，五子拉代，

v.en: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
v.zh: 他张弓将我当作箭靶子。

v.en: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.
v.zh: 我要因你欢喜快乐；至高者啊，我要歌颂你的名！

v.en: Great are your tender mercies, LORD. Revive me according to your ordinances.
v.zh: 耶和华啊，你的慈悲本为大；求你照你的典章将我救活。

v.en: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.
v.zh: 如此住在你殿中的便为有福！他们仍要赞美你。（细拉）

v.en: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!
v.zh: 他们在旷野悖逆他，在荒地叫他担忧，何其多呢！

v.en: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,
v.zh: 他使饥饿的人住在那里，好建造可住的城邑，

v.en: I would declare to him the number of my steps. I would go near to him like a prince.
v.zh: 我必向他述说我脚步的数目，必如君王进到他面前。

g: to draw off; to rescue; to equip

v.en: They will go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD, but they won’t find him. He has withdrawn himself from them.
v.zh: 他们必牵着牛羊去寻求耶和华，却寻不见；他已经转去离开他们。

v.en: The noise of the whip, the noise of the rattling of wheels, prancing horses, and bounding chariots,
v.zh: 鞭声响亮，车轮轰轰，马匹踢跳，车辆奔腾，

g: to be innocent, free of guilt

v.en: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.
v.zh: 谁能知道自己的错失呢？愿你赦免我隐而未现的过错。

v.en: The LORD’s angel solemnly assured Joshua, saying,
v.zh: 耶和华的使者告诫约书亚说：

v.en: His servants conspired against him, and put him to death in his own house.
v.zh: 他的臣仆背叛，在宫里杀了他。

v.en: The foreigners will fade away, and will come trembling out of their close places.
v.zh: 外邦人要衰残，战战兢兢地出他们的营寨。

v.en: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.
v.zh: 我的日子比梭更快，都消耗在无指望之中。

v.en: Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!
v.zh: 你们当向神―我们的力量大声欢呼，向雅各的神发声欢乐！

v.en: Haven’t you poured me out like milk, and curdled me like cheese?
v.zh: 你不是倒出我来好像奶，使我凝结如同奶饼吗？

v.en: A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.
v.zh: 境内有打仗和大毁灭的响声。

v.en: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.
v.zh: 他们心中试探神，随自己所欲的求食物，

v.en: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.
v.zh: 试看恶人因奸恶而劬劳，所怀的是毒害，所生的是虚假。

v.en: and their king will go into captivity, he and his princes together,” says the LORD.
v.zh: 他们的王和首领必一同被掳去。这是耶和华说的。

v.en: You have increased your merchants more than the stars of the skies. The grasshopper strips and flees away.
v.zh: 你增添商贾，多过天上的星；蝻子吃尽而去。

v.en: For his God instructs him in right judgment and teaches him.
v.zh: 因为他的神教导他务农相宜，并且指教他。

v.en: You have despised my holy things, and have profaned my Sabbaths.
v.zh: 你藐视了我的圣物，干犯了我的安息日。

v.en: I will thrust you from your office. You will be pulled down from your station.
v.zh: 我必赶逐你离开官职；你必从你的原位撤下。』

v.en: that he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.
v.zh: a

v.en: Behold, you are beautiful, my beloved, yes, pleasant; and our couch is verdant.
v.zh: 我的良人哪，你甚美丽可爱！我们以青草为床榻，

v.en: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,
v.zh: 谋略必护卫你；聪明必保守你，

v.en: Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
v.zh: 系在你指头上，刻在你心版上。

v.en: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,
v.zh: 义人看见他们的结局就欢喜；无辜的人嗤笑他们，

v.en: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their donkeys.
v.zh: 天一亮就打发那些人带着驴走了。

v.en: The men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.
v.zh: 各兵丁都为自己夺了财物。

v.en: Thus they were defiled with their works, and prostituted themselves in their deeds.
v.zh: 这样，他们被自己所做的污秽了，在行为上犯了邪淫。

v.en: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.
v.zh: 智慧在街市上呼喊，在宽阔处发声，

v.en: then I will command my blessing on you in the sixth year, and it shall bear fruit for the three years.
v.zh: 我必在第六年将我所命的福赐给你们，地便生三年的土产。

v.en: For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.
v.zh: 忿怒害死愚妄人；嫉妒杀死痴迷人。

v.en: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,
v.zh: 蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，细麻，山羊毛，

v.en: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.
v.zh: 你却高举了我的角，如野牛的角；我是被新油膏了的。

v.en: and for the drink offering you shall offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
v.zh: 又用酒一欣三分之一作奠祭，献给耶和华为馨香之祭。

v.en: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,
v.zh: 你从天上使人听判断。神起来施行审判，要救地上一切谦卑的人；那时地就惧怕而静默。（细拉）

v.en: By wisdom the LORD founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.
v.zh: 耶和华以智慧立地，以聪明定天，

v.en: “Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!”
v.zh: 「你们离开这会众，我好在转眼之间把他们灭绝。」

v.en: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.
v.zh: 唱起诗歌，打手鼓，弹美琴与瑟。

v.en: Of the Levites, certain divisions in Judah settled in Benjamin’s territory.
v.zh: 利未人中有几班曾住在犹大地归于便雅悯的。

v.en: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, “Get Micaiah the son of Imla quickly.”
v.zh: 以色列王就召了一个太监来，说：「你快去将音拉的儿子米该雅召来。」

v.en: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;
v.zh: 灯台上有四个杯，形状像杏花，有球，有花。

v.en: marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,
v.zh: 为它定界限，又安门和闩，

v.en: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”
v.zh: 惟有听从我的，必安然居住，得享安静，不怕灾祸。

v.en: My sister, my bride, is a locked up garden; a locked up spring, a sealed fountain.
v.zh: 我妹子，我新妇，乃是关锁的园，禁闭的井，封闭的泉源。

v.en: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.
v.zh: 他们摇摇晃晃，东倒西歪，好像醉酒的人；他们的智慧无法可施。

v.en: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.
v.zh: 我心渴想你的救恩，仰望你的应许。

v.en: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.
v.zh: 不料是你；你原与我平等，是我的同伴，是我知己的朋友！

v.en: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
v.zh: 当存畏惧事奉耶和华，又当存战兢而快乐。

v.en: All Judah stood before the LORD, with their little ones, their wives, and their children.
v.zh: 犹大众人和他们的婴孩、妻子、儿女都站在耶和华面前。

v.en: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. He has plucked my hope up like a tree.
v.zh: 他在四围攻击我，我便归于死亡，将我的指望如树拔出来。

v.en: who says to the deep, ‘Be dry,’ and ‘I will dry up your rivers,’
v.zh: 对深渊说：你干了吧！我也要使你的江河干涸。

v.en: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,
v.zh: 蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，细麻，山羊毛，

v.en: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.
v.zh: 他打开磐石，水就涌出；在干旱之处，水流成河。

v.en: Israel, your prophets have been like foxes in the waste places.
v.zh: 以色列啊，你的先知好像荒场中的狐狸，

v.en: “You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.
v.zh: 不可苦待寡妇和孤儿；

v.en: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,
v.zh: 蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，细麻，山羊毛，

v.en: If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.
v.zh: 智慧人与愚妄人相争，或怒或笑，总不能使他止息。

v.en: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.
v.zh: 我的仇敌转身退去的时候，他们一见你的面就跌倒灭亡。

v.en: at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.
v.zh: 都因那辱骂毁谤人的声音，又因仇敌和报仇人的缘故。

v.en: She arms her waist with strength, and makes her arms strong.
v.zh: 她以能力束腰，使膀臂有力。

v.en: His strength will be famished. Calamity will be ready at his side.
v.zh: 他的力量必因饥饿衰败；祸患要在他旁边等候。

g: to be righteous, in the right

v.en: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.
v.zh: 你们当为贫寒的人和孤儿伸冤；当为困苦和穷乏的人施行公义。

v.en: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.
v.zh: 约兰年间，以东人背叛犹大，脱离他的权下，自己立王。

v.en: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
v.zh: 若女子的父亲决不肯将女子给他，他就要按处女的聘礼，交出钱来。

v.en: Then the LORD was jealous for his land, and had pity on his people.
v.zh: 耶和华就为自己的地发热心，怜恤他的百姓。

v.en: but these lay in wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.
v.zh: 这些人埋伏，是为自流己血；蹲伏，是为自害己命。

v.en: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.
v.zh: 你们用荆棘烧火，锅还未热，他要用旋风把青的和烧着的一齐刮去。

v.en: Give ear to my words, LORD. Consider my meditation.
v.zh: 耶和华啊，求你留心听我的言语，顾念我的心思！

v.en: “Also, Judah, there is a harvest appointed for you, when I restore the fortunes of my people.
v.zh: 犹大啊，我使被掳之民归回的时候，必有为你所命定的收场。

v.en: he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,
v.zh: 挺着颈项，用盾牌的厚凸面向全能者直闯；

v.en: A contemplation by David, when he was in the cave. A Prayer.
v.zh: （大卫在洞里作的训诲诗，乃是祈祷。）

v.en: Now the Philistines had come and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
v.zh: 非利士人来了，布散在利乏音谷。

v.en: Better is open rebuke than hidden love.
v.zh: 当面的责备强如背地的爱情。

v.en: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
v.zh: 人在幼年负轭，这原是好的。

v.en: Now an omer is one tenth of an ephah.
v.zh: （俄梅珥就是伊法十分之一。）

v.en: “You shall not steal.
v.zh: 「『不可偷盗。

v.en: “An astonishing and horrible thing has happened in the land.
v.zh: 国中有可惊骇、可憎恶的事：

v.en: Then all Judah brought the tithe of the grain, the new wine, and the oil to the treasuries.
v.zh: 犹大众人就把五谷、新酒，和油的十分之一送入库房。

v.en: Of all clean birds you may eat.
v.zh: 「凡洁净的鸟，你们都可以吃。

v.en: Now this is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).
v.zh: 以扫就是以东，他的后代记在下面。

v.en: The new wine mourns. The vine languishes. All the merry-hearted sigh.
v.zh: 新酒悲哀，葡萄树衰残；心中欢乐的俱都叹息。

v.en: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.
v.zh: 但招聚会众的时候，你们要吹号，却不要吹出大声。

v.en: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.
v.zh: 神啊，你是我们的盾牌；求你垂顾观看你受膏者的面！

v.en: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”
v.zh: 我曾说：恐怕他们向我夸耀；我失脚的时候，他们向我夸大。

v.en: Also you will lie down, and no one will make you afraid. Yes, many will court your favor.
v.zh: 你躺卧，无人惊吓，且有许多人向你求恩。

v.en: The famine was severe in the land.
v.zh: 那地的饥荒甚大。

v.en: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.
v.zh: 他也击打他们的葡萄树和无花果树，毁坏他们境内的树木。

v.en: I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will solve my riddle on the harp.
v.zh: 我要侧耳听比喻，用琴解谜语。

v.en: She seeks wool and flax, and works eagerly with her hands.
v.zh: 她寻找羊羢和麻，甘心用手做工。

v.en: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
v.zh: 你要以你的训言引导我，以后必接我到荣耀里。

v.en: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.
v.zh: 你使我们当作快要被吃的羊，把我们分散在列邦中。

v.en: Have you found honey? Eat as much as is sufficient for you, lest you eat too much, and vomit it.
v.zh: 你得了蜜吗？只可吃够而已，恐怕你过饱就呕吐出来。

v.en: Behold, their valiant ones cry outside; the ambassadors of peace weep bitterly.
v.zh: 看哪，他们的豪杰在外头哀号；求和的使臣痛痛哭泣。

v.en: There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.
v.zh: 有人挪移地界，抢夺群畜而牧养。

v.en: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.
v.zh: 求你也照样用狂风追赶他们，用暴雨恐吓他们。

v.en: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.
v.zh: 就要禁止舌头不出恶言，嘴唇不说诡诈的话。

v.en: “Everything devoted in Israel shall be yours.
v.zh: 以色列中一切永献的都必归与你。

v.en: The days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years.
v.zh: 以撒共活了一百八十岁。

v.en: All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.
v.zh: 众人都要害怕，要传扬神的工作，并且明白他的作为。

v.en: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”
v.zh: 你们愚蒙人，要舍弃愚蒙，就得存活，并要走光明的道。

v.en: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.
v.zh: 我的神啊，我要鼓瑟称赞你，称赞你的诚实！以色列的圣者啊，我要弹琴歌颂你！

v.en: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.
v.zh: 愿海和其中所充满的澎湃；世界和住在其间的也要发声。

g: to be humiliated, put to shame

v.en: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.
v.zh: 但如今你丢弃了我们，使我们受辱，不和我们的军兵同去。

v.en: and of cassia five hundred, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; and a hin of olive oil.
v.zh: 桂皮五百舍客勒，都按着圣所的平，又取橄榄油一欣，

v.en: Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north.
v.zh: 暴风出于南宫；寒冷出于北方。

v.en: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?
v.zh: 人若怀里搋火，衣服岂能不烧呢？

v.en: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder,
v.zh: 他为雨露定命令，为雷电定道路。

v.en: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,
v.zh: 蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，细麻，山羊毛，

v.en: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.
v.zh: 他要挫折王子的骄气；他向地上的君王显威可畏。

v.en: The threshing floors will be full of wheat, and the vats will overflow with new wine and oil.
v.zh: 禾场必满了麦子；酒榨与油榨必有新酒和油盈溢。

v.en: “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.
v.zh: 现在这些人以我为歌曲，以我为笑谈。

v.en: Maacah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.
v.zh: 迦勒的妾玛迦生示别、特哈拿，

v.en: Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
v.zh: 比利家、以利加拿是约柜前守门的。

v.en: She went down to the threshing floor, and did everything that her mother-in-law told her.
v.zh: 路得就下到场上，照她婆婆所吩咐她的而行。

v.en: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.
v.zh: 他数点星宿的数目，一一称他的名。

v.en: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.
v.zh: 他家中有货物，有钱财；他的公义存到永远。

g: to contain, hold; to sustain, provide

v.en: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.
v.zh: 施恩与人、借贷与人的，这人事情顺利；他被审判的时候要诉明自己的冤。

g: to deal with, repay; to wean

v.en: Return to your rest, my soul, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.
v.zh: 我的心哪！你要仍归安乐，因为耶和华用厚恩待你。

v.en: He sees everything that is high. He is king over all the sons of pride.”
v.zh: 凡高大的，它无不藐视；它在骄傲的水族上作王。

v.en: fear came on me, and trembling, which made all my bones shake.
v.zh: 恐惧、战兢临到我身，使我百骨打战。

v.en: The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.
v.zh: 恶人窥探义人，想要杀他。

v.en: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth,
v.zh: 坚固的城就是：西丁、侧耳、哈末、拉甲、基尼烈、

v.en: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.
v.zh: 你给它们，它们便拾起来；你张手，它们饱得美食。

v.en: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
v.zh: 我又用没药、沉香、桂皮薰了我的榻。

v.en: a fountain of gardens, a well of living waters, flowing streams from Lebanon.
v.zh: 你是园中的泉，活水的井，从黎巴嫩流下来的溪水。

v.en: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!
v.zh: 义人必因耶和华欢喜，并要投靠他；凡心里正直的人都要夸口。

v.en: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.
v.zh: 你向敬畏你的人所应许的话，求你向仆人坚定！

v.en: The LORD is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.
v.zh: 耶和华是他百姓的力量，又是他受膏者得救的保障。

v.en: The son of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who committed a trespass in the devoted thing.
v.zh: 迦米的儿子是亚干，这亚干在当灭的物上犯了罪，连累了以色列人。

v.en: A workman has cast an image, and the goldsmith overlays it with gold, and casts silver chains for it.
v.zh: 偶像是匠人铸造，银匠用金包裹，为它铸造银链。

v.en: If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.
v.zh: 智慧人与愚妄人相争，或怒或笑，总不能使他止息。

v.en: When you blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall go forward.
v.zh: 吹出大声的时候，东边安的营都要起行。

v.en: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.
v.zh: 许多人以我为怪，但你是我坚固的避难所。

v.en: The LORD executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.
v.zh: 耶和华施行公义，为一切受屈的人伸冤。

v.en: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.
v.zh: 他的闪电光照世界，大地看见便震动。

v.en: I will also clothe her priests with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.
v.zh: 我要使祭司披上救恩，圣民大声欢呼！

g: to be humbled, subdued; to subdue

v.en: Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.
v.zh: 他们的仇敌也欺压他们，他们就伏在敌人手下。

v.en: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.
v.zh: 你在我前后环绕我，按手在我身上。

v.en: Precious in the LORD’s sight is the death of his saints.
v.zh: 在耶和华眼中，看圣民之死极为宝贵。

v.en: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,
v.zh: 那些坐在黑暗中、死荫里的人被困苦和铁链捆锁，

v.en: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning’s dawn and the evening with songs of joy.
v.zh: 住在地极的人因你的神迹惧怕；你使日出日落之地都欢呼。

v.en: (I have certainly not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse);
v.zh: （我没有容口犯罪，咒诅他的生命；）

v.en: We have sinned with our fathers. We have committed iniquity. We have done wickedly.
v.zh: 我们与我们的祖宗一同犯罪；我们作了孽，行了恶。

v.en: He couched, he lay down as a lion, as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone who curses you is cursed.”
v.zh: 他蹲如公狮，卧如母狮，谁敢惹他？凡给你祝福的，愿他蒙福；凡咒诅你的，愿他受咒诅。

v.en: Examine me, LORD, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.
v.zh: 耶和华啊，求你察看我，试验我，熬炼我的肺腑心肠。

v.en: Because I knew that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your brow bronze;
v.zh: 因为我素来知道你是顽梗的―你的颈项是铁的；你的额是铜的。

v.en: Yet God preserves the mighty by his power. He rises up who has no assurance of life.
v.zh: 然而神用能力保全有势力的人；那性命难保的人仍然兴起。

v.en: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their strongholds.
v.zh: 外邦人要衰残，战战兢兢地出他们的营寨。

v.en: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
v.zh: 住在至高者隐密处的，必住在全能者的荫下。

v.en: I did to them according to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions. I hid my face from them.
v.zh: 我是照他们的污秽和罪过待他们，并且我掩面不顾他们。」

v.en: “‘The priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall wipe them into the water of bitterness.
v.zh: 「祭司要写这咒诅的话，将所写的字抹在苦水里，

v.en: when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,
v.zh: 上使穹苍坚硬，下使渊源稳固，

v.en: Pass over to Tarshish! Wail, you inhabitants of the coast!
v.zh: 泰尔人哪，你们当过到他施去；沿海的居民哪，你们都当哀号。

v.en: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will punish all those who are circumcised only in their flesh:
v.zh: 耶和华说：「看哪，日子将到，我要刑罚一切受过割礼、心却未受割礼的，

v.en: “‘Behold, the day! Behold, it comes! Your doom has gone out. The rod has blossomed. Pride has budded.
v.zh: 「看哪，看哪，日子快到了，所定的灾已经发出。杖已经开花，骄傲已经发芽。

v.en: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.
v.zh: 帝王荣耀在乎民多；君王衰败在乎民少。

v.en: Turn to the stronghold, you prisoners of hope! Even today I declare that I will restore double to you.
v.zh: 你们被囚而有指望的人都要转回保障。我今日说明，我必加倍赐福给你们。

v.en: Whom do you pass in beauty? Go down, and be laid with the uncircumcised.
v.zh: 你埃及的美丽胜过谁呢？你下去与未受割礼的人一同躺卧吧！

v.en: It was so, that when any man came near to bow down to him, he stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and kissed him.
v.zh: 若有人近前来要拜押沙龙，押沙龙就伸手拉住他，与他亲嘴。

v.en: I have seen Ephraim, like Tyre, planted in a pleasant place; but Ephraim will bring out his children to the murderer.
v.zh: 我看以法莲如泰尔栽于美地。以法莲却要将自己的儿女带出来，交与行杀戮的人。

v.en: Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint; but one who keeps the law is blessed.
v.zh: 没有异象（或译：默示），民就放肆；惟遵守律法的，便为有福。

v.en: A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.
v.zh: 智慧的王簸散恶人，用碌碡滚轧他们。

v.en: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen.
v.zh: 王带着哈曼来赴王后以斯帖的筵席。

v.en: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.
v.zh: 他们在何烈山造了牛犊，叩拜铸成的像。

v.en: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.

v.zh: 利亚又怀孕，给雅各生了第六个儿子。

v.en: They said, “There must be an inheritance for those who are escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe not be blotted out from Israel.
v.zh: 又说：「便雅悯逃脱的人当有地业，免得以色列中涂抹了一个支派。

v.en: I will make the land desolate, because they have acted unfaithfully,” says the Lord GOD.
v.zh: 我必使地土荒凉，因为他们行事干犯我。这是主耶和华说的。」

v.en: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.
v.zh: 他数点星宿的数目，一一称他的名。

v.en: but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.
v.zh: 反倒在旷野大起欲心，在荒地试探神。

v.en: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
v.zh: 第八约哈难，第九以利萨巴，

v.en: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, but not with a perfect heart.
v.zh: 亚玛谢行耶和华眼中看为正的事，只是心不专诚。

v.en: All the assembly said that they would do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
v.zh: 全会众都说可以如此行；这事在众民眼中都看为好。

v.en: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
v.zh: 愿我的对头披戴羞辱！愿他们以自己的羞愧为外袍遮身！

v.en: Then he will return into his land with great wealth. His heart will be against the holy covenant. He will take action, and return to his own land.
v.zh: 北方王（原文是他）必带许多财宝回往本国，他的心反对圣约，任意而行，回到本地。

v.en: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine.
v.zh: 我儿，你心若存智慧，我的心也甚欢喜。

v.en: Behold, children are a heritage of the LORD. The fruit of the womb is his reward.
v.zh: 儿女是耶和华所赐的产业；所怀的胎是他所给的赏赐。

g: reeds, rushes; יַם־סוּף, the Sea of Reeds

v.en: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.
v.zh: 从以琳起行，安营在红海边。

v.en: Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.
v.zh: 神啊，求你留心听我的祷告，不要隐藏不听我的恳求！

v.en: in addition to that which the traders brought, and the traffic of the merchants, and of all the kings of the mixed people, and of the governors of the country.
v.zh: 另外还有商人和杂族（杂族在历代下九章十四节是阿拉伯）的诸王，与国中的省长所进的金子。

v.en: “From the time that the continual burnt offering is taken away and the abomination that makes desolate set up, there will be one thousand two hundred ninety days.
v.zh: 从除掉常献的燔祭，并设立那行毁坏可憎之物的时候，必有一千二百九十日。

g: to be hard, difficult; to harden

v.en: Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,
v.zh: 你们不可硬着心，像当日在米利巴，就是在旷野的玛撒。

v.en: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.
v.zh: 他们在何烈山造了牛犊，叩拜铸成的像。

v.en: “You shall take the ram of consecration and boil its meat in a holy place.
v.zh: 「你要将承接圣职所献公羊的肉煮在圣处。

g: to entice, deceive; to be simple

v.en: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.
v.zh: 他们却用口谄媚他，用舌向他说谎。

g: to pass on, change; to replace

v.en: Then they sweep by like the wind and go on. They are indeed guilty, whose strength is their god.”
v.zh: 他以自己的势力为神，像风猛然扫过，显为有罪。

v.en: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.
v.zh: 恶人想得坏人的网罗；义人的根得以结实。

v.en: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.
v.zh: 但神要打破他仇敌的头，就是那常犯罪之人的发顶。

v.en: Ephraim will become a desolation in the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel, I have made known that which will surely be.
v.zh: 在责罚的日子，以法莲必变为荒场；我在以色列支派中，指示将来必成的事。

v.en: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.
v.zh: 他封闭水不得滴流，使隐藏的物显露出来。

v.en: Madmenah is a fugitive. The inhabitants of Gebim flee for safety.
v.zh: 玛得米那人躲避；基柄的居民逃遁。

v.en: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,
v.zh: 染红的公羊皮，海狗皮，皂荚木，

v.en: “Go out of the ship, you, your wife, your sons, and your sons’ wives with you.
v.zh: 「你和你的妻子、儿子、儿妇都可以出方舟。

v.en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. LORD, you have searched me, and you know me.
v.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）耶和华啊，你已经鉴察我，认识我。

v.en: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.
v.zh: 愿你派一个恶人辖制他，派一个对头站在他右边！

v.en: Abraham was old, and well advanced in age. The LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.
v.zh: 亚伯拉罕年纪老迈，向来在一切事上耶和华都赐福给他。

v.en: For Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.
v.zh: 在西面街道上有四个，在游廊上有两个。

g: cover of the ark, mercy seat

v.en: the ark of the covenant with its poles, the mercy seat,
v.zh: 法柜和柜的杠并施恩座，

v.en: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.
v.zh: 眼有光，使心喜乐；好信息，使骨滋润。

v.en: Out of Jacob shall one have dominion, and shall destroy the remnant from the city.”
v.zh: 有一位出于雅各的，必掌大权；他要除灭城中的余民。

v.en: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.
v.zh: 我必不背弃我的约，也不改变我口中所出的。

v.en: Wrap up the covenant. Seal the law among my disciples.
v.zh: 你要卷起律法书，在我门徒中间封住训诲。

v.en: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,
v.zh: 无赖的恶徒，行动就用乖僻的口，

v.en: Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.
v.zh: 你从有野食之山而来，有光华和荣美。

v.en: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.
v.zh: 愿他们的筵席在他们面前变为网罗，在他们平安的时候变为机槛。

v.en: He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,
v.zh: 他为自己的怒气修平了路，将他们交给瘟疫，使他们死亡，

v.en: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.
v.zh: 在水中立楼阁的栋梁，用云彩为车辇，藉着风的翅膀而行，

v.en: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.
v.zh: 愚妄人犯罪，以为戏耍（或译：赎愆祭愚弄愚妄人）；正直人互相喜悦。

v.en: to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;
v.zh: 为要报复列邦，刑罚万民。

g: to take a pledge; to ruin

v.en: “My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct and the grave is ready for me.
v.zh: 我的心灵消耗，我的日子灭尽；坟墓为我预备好了。

v.en: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.
v.zh: 他必救你脱离捕鸟人的网罗和毒害的瘟疫。

v.en: My soul shall be joyful in the LORD. It shall rejoice in his salvation.
v.zh: 我的心必靠耶和华快乐，靠他的救恩高兴。

g: to tear away, pull off, snap

v.en: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.
v.zh: 他从黑暗中和死荫里领他们出来，折断他们的绑索。

v.en: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat of its increase out of the field.
v.zh: 因为这是禧年，你们要当作圣年，吃地中自出的土产。

v.en: There were arches all around, twenty-five cubits long and five cubits wide.
v.zh: 周围有廊子，长二十五肘，宽五肘。

v.en: The remnant of the trees of his forest shall be few, so that a child could write their number.
v.zh: 他林中剩下的树必稀少，就是孩子也能写其数。

v.en: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them.
v.zh: 他们这样行，惹耶和华发怒，便有瘟疫流行在他们中间。

v.en: He built the inner court with three courses of cut stone and a course of cedar beams.
v.zh: 他又用凿成的石头三层、香柏木一层建筑内院。

v.en: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.
v.zh: 我因禁食，膝骨软弱；我身上的肉也渐渐瘦了。

v.en: Blow the trumpet in Zion! Sanctify a fast. Call a solemn assembly.
v.zh: 你们要在锡安吹角，分定禁食的日子，宣告严肃会。

v.en: “Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,
v.zh: 海水冲出，如出胎胞，那时谁将它关闭呢？

v.en: The priest shall take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the middle of the burning of the heifer.
v.zh: 祭司要把香柏木、牛膝草、朱红色线都丢在烧牛的火中。

v.en: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem, and built cities for defense in Judah.
v.zh: 罗波安住在耶路撒冷，在犹大地修筑城邑，

v.en: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
v.zh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

v.en: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, LORD, for it is good.
v.zh: 我要把甘心祭献给你。耶和华啊，我要称赞你的名；这名本为美好。

v.en: Behold, the LORD’s storm, his wrath, has gone out. Yes, a whirling storm! It will burst on the head of the wicked.
v.zh: 看哪！耶和华的忿怒好像暴风，已经发出；是暴烈的旋风，必转到恶人的头上。

v.en: A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.
v.zh: 与众寡合的，独自寻求心愿，并恼恨一切真智慧。

g: to meet, confront; to come before

v.en: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.
v.zh: 我趁天未亮呼求；我仰望了你的言语。

v.en: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.
v.zh: 你安置月亮为定节令；日头自知沉落。

v.en: They have passed away as the swift ships, as the eagle that swoops on the prey.
v.zh: 我的日子过去如快船，如急落抓食的鹰。

v.en: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.
v.zh: 我为瞎子的眼，瘸子的脚。

v.en: Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.
v.zh: 不要劳碌求富，休仗自己的聪明。

v.en: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
v.zh: 他必按公平引领谦卑人，将他的道教训他们。

v.en: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.
v.zh: 他终日恩待人，借给人；他的后裔也蒙福！

v.en: I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.
v.zh: 我向你呼吁，求你救我！我要遵守你的法度。

v.en: Am I a sea, or a sea monster, that you put a guard over me?
v.zh: 我对神说：我岂是洋海，岂是大鱼，你竟防守我呢？

v.en: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,
v.zh: 点灯的油并做膏油和香的香料，
